decisions.reason: Tighter optical spacing changes the gaps between letterforms, not the locked geometry or revision policy of the Hero V.
The common-baseline instruction is an independent requirement introduced by the same message and is already represented; the kerning change does not modify its alignment rule.
Tighter spacing does not change the second V's established relative height or subordinate visual role.
The source changes spacing around the E and L but does not change their geometry, architectural language, proportions, or originality constraints.
Optical spacing throughout the wordmark does not redraw or otherwise modify the second V glyph geometry.
The kerning change does not alter the required shared peak alignment between the Hero V and É accent.
Tighter horizontal spacing does not change the E and L cap-height scale established relative to the second V.
The composition-spacing request does not resume or modify the deferred champagne material treatment.
Tighter kerning does not change the É accent's literal derivation from the approved Hero V terminal.
The spacing direction does not change the locked shared signature terminal treatment.
Requesting composition variations does not change the obligation to explain the design rationale for review rounds.
